# Draft:WAR Clicc Music Group

----
WAR Clicc Music Group (WCMG) is an American hip hop collective and independent record label based in Gardena, California. Originally active as a rap group from 2000 to 2006, the members reunited in 2018 and formally launched WCMG in 2019. The group is composed of rappers Kacee, Shocaze, and IDea Tha Rapper (formerly Sinister Sin).
The label is known for its West Coast sound, emphasis on creative ownership, and its catalog of releases spanning group projects, solo albums, and compilation works.
History
Formation (1999–2000)
WAR Clicc traces its origins to childhood friendships formed in Gardena, California. The members grew up around 139th Street and Ardath Avenue, frequently playing basketball together and bonding over hip hop. Their earliest recordings were made in the late 1990s on a karaoke machine at the home of friend Spook 3.
Before adopting the name WAR Clicc, the group performed as The Soul MC’s, a lineup that included member Jermaine (known as .Com), a close friend of rapper Nipsey Hussle. In July 2000, the group transitioned to a trio and officially adopted the name WAR Clicc, an acronym for World Ain’t Ready Clicc.
Early Years and BaccBone Crew (2000–2006)
During the early 2000s, WAR Clicc developed a sound rooted in G-funk, battle rap, and lyrical street mixtape traditions. In 2001, members of the group toured with Coolio, Nu Flavor, and Spread Tha Newz, marking their first major performance experience.
In 2003, the group expanded into a larger collective known as the BaccBone Crew (BBC), which included Spook 3, Mizzle, and Kirk Migirt — childhood friends also from the Gardena neighborhood known locally as “BaccBone.” The collective recorded extensively, with both full-group and mixed-member tracks, most of which were later compiled into The BaccBone Anthology.
Following internal conflicts and creative disagreements, WAR Clicc disbanded in 2006.
Reunion and Creation of WCMG (2018–2019)
After over a decade apart, the members reconnected in 2018 and held meetings at IDea Tha Rapper’s apartment to discuss rekindling the group. All members had continued writing during the hiatus, while Kacee had begun producing music independently.
This reunion led to the formation of WAR Clicc Music Group, an independent label focused on creative control and ownership. The group recorded their official debut album, The World Ain’t Safe, at Pacifiq Media Studios in Gardena. Released in 2019, it marked the first entry in WCMG’s unified catalog system.
Modern Era and Expansion (2020–Present)
From 2020 onward, Kacee emerged as the primary producer for WAR Clicc and WCMG’s associated artists, utilizing FL Studio, Magix Music Maker, and an MPC Mini for production.
WCMG expanded with the involvement of:
Cali E-Well, a Pasadena-based artist who inspired Kacee’s musical return and officially joined WCMG in 2025.
01, a rapper and professionally trained audio engineer with a studio in Gardena, who became the technical backbone of WCMG’s recording process.
The label continued releasing solo works, group singles, and compilation projects, culminating in the release of Chess Not Checkers Vol.1 (WCMG009) in 2025.
Musical Style
WAR Clicc’s sound spans:
West Coast hip hop
G-funk–influenced production
Lyrical street rap
Motivational and cultural themes
Modern independent hip hop aesthetics
Members
Core Members
Kacee – Rapper, producer, executive
Shocaze – Rapper
IDea Tha Rapper (Sinister Sin) – Rapper, early-era producer
Affiliated Artists / Contributors
Cali E-Well – Rapper (joined 2025)
01 – Engineer, rapper
